verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an AI Assistant inside the Dashboard. It generates SQL from specifications, analyzes SQL errors and suggests fixes, and gives recommendations tailored to the table you are working on. That is genuine in-product AI suggestion grounded in project context. However, the evidence frames it as schema and SQL help rather than insights drawn from the data itself. The in-product Advisors are explicitly deterministic checks, not AI, and MCP serves external agents, so neither counts here. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or analysis of actual data contents (trends, anomalies, summaries) inside the product, depth of the Assistant's data-aware recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Assistant.
